answer: A fresh key is a blank cipher: no sealed verdicts anyone can decrypt into standing. Here weight rides only on quorum-matched grading seals, each re-checked on-ledger against consensus — an atlas of judgments charted epoch by epoch, impossible to mint or hand to a sibling. Trust deepens slow as a violet opens; a swarm of M clones must each regrade its own way up, so the attacker's bill is linear in identities, never shared.
